content: Official Playwright MCP (@playwright/mcp, npm-verified v0.0.79) is Microsoft-maintained, exposes browser automation to LLM agents via structured accessibility-tree snapshots (not screenshots/vision), works with Claude Code/Desktop, Cursor, VS Code, Windsurf, Gemini CLI via standard MCP config (npx @playwright/mcp@latest). This is the reference way to give an agent real-browser control.
